title: Is this Billboard Hot 100 hit AI slop?
summary: Fenix Flexin's Billboard Hot 100 hit 'Rubberz' has raised suspicions about its AI-generated origins. The song's dramatic left turn from trap-influenced West Coast rap to 80s UK synth pop, along with its low-quality recording artifacts, has led many to speculate that AI was involved. While AI music detectors are not entirely reliable, supporting materials such as the single's cover art and lyrics have been flagged as AI-generated with high certainty.

title: Judge denies xAI’s request to block Minnesota ban on ‘nudify’ apps
summary: xAI's request to block Minnesota's ban on 'nudify' apps was denied by U.S. District Judge Donovan Frank. The ban was signed nearly three months ago, and xAI filed its request for a temporary restraining order just three days before the law was set to take effect. This ruling allows the law to take effect while the lawsuit proceeds, which xAI argues is overly restrictive and has less restrictive alternatives.
